title: Merit List (Comparable)
statementMd:
Make `Student` implement `Comparable<Student>` so that `Collections.sort` orders students by **marks, highest first**, and students with equal marks **alphabetically by name**. `main` is already written.

**Input**
Line 1: `n`. Then n lines: `name marks` (a name has no spaces).

**Output**
The students in merit order, one `name marks` per line.
hints: compareTo returns negative / zero / positive. Integer.compare(other.marks, marks) sorts marks high → low.
Only when marks are equal, fall back to name.compareTo(other.name).
